name: Five-Factor (OCEAN) Brand Mapping
diagnostic: If evaluated through standardized psychometric testing, what exact trait distribution governs our corporate communications?
artifact: A radar chart scoring the five factors: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism.
trap: Mirroring the founder's uncalibrated traits instead of engineering the profile the target market requires.

origin.line: Gian Vittorio Caprara, Claudio Barbaranelli & Gianluigi Guido (2001)

pedigreeFull: Gian Vittorio Caprara, Claudio Barbaranelli, & Gianluigi Guido (Journal of Economic Psychology, 2001). Adaptation of the gold-standard Costa & McCrae Big Five psychometric model (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism) to enterprise positioning.
artifactFull: An OCEAN Polar Radar Chart scoring Openness to Experience (intellectual curiosity), Conscientiousness (operational reliability), Extraversion (conversational assertiveness), Agreeableness (empathy and support), and Neuroticism (environmental volatility and urgency).
trapFull: Mirroring the executive founder's uncalibrated personal traits rather than engineering the deliberate behavioral profile required by the target market.
